Questions from macOS, Hackintosh and Linux users are welcome. You do not need to reproduce a bug to ask a question.

Before posting, see the getting-started guide and FAQ linked from the root README.

## Question

What would you like to know?

## Context (optional)

Which platform, version target or documentation page are you asking about? Include CPU or host details only if relevant. Do not include serial numbers, credentials or private data.

If you have actually tested a build, use the hardware or bug report template instead. For sensitive security reports, follow SECURITY.md.
